levels.title: Level 1: Beginner
levels.description: Learn vowels and consonants: Master the Telugu alphabet foundation. Learn all 16 vowels (అ, ఆ, ఇ, ఈ, ఉ, ఊ, ఋ, ఎ, ఏ, ఐ, ఒ, ఓ, ఔ, అం, అః) and 36 consonants (క, ఖ, గ, ఘ, ఙ, చ, ఛ, జ, ఝ, ఞ, ట, ఠ, డ, ఢ, ణ, త, థ, ద, ధ, న, ప, ఫ, బ, భ, మ, య, ర, ల, వ, శ, ష, స, హ, ళ, క్ష, ఱ). Build your reading foundation!

levels.title: Level 2: Basic
levels.description: Read simple words and learn గుణింతాలు: Master consonant-vowel combinations (guninthalu) to read Telugu words. Learn how consonants combine with vowels to form syllables like క + ఆ = కా, క + ఇ = కి. Practice reading simple words like కాకి (crow), కుక్క (dog), మామ (uncle). Build your word reading skills!

levels.title: Level 3: Intermediate
levels.description: Intermediate level: Read and write simple sentences. Explanation: Use SOV order and present tense forms. Examples: నేను నీరు త్రాగుతాను; నేను పాఠం చదువుతాను.

levels.title: Level 4: Advanced
levels.description: Advanced level: Complex sentences and formal usage. Explanation: Conditionals, passive voice, and idioms in context. Examples: అయితే, అయినా constructions; formal మీరు/తమరు forms.
